## About
Final-year Mechatronics Engineering student at Sathyabama Institute of Science &
Technology, working at the intersection of AI and robotics.

Hands-on across the full robotics stack — ROS/ROS2, MoveIt, RViz, Gazebo, URDF, and
hardware control via Arduino/ESP32 — with deep AI experience spanning LLMs, agentic
systems, multimodal inference, computer vision, and reinforcement learning.

Currently COO at Avixr Technologies and an active open-source contributor to LangChain,
with 64 GitHub stars across 37 repositories and 1,241+ commits.

- Primary Focus: AI & Robotics
- Secondary: Mobile Development, Full-Stack, IoT

## Featured Projects
(Categories: Robotics, AI, CS. Status and star counts as shown on the site.)

### Real-Time Robotic Arm Control — Robotics — Completed
End-to-end ROS2 control pipeline driving a physical robotic arm in real time using MoveIt
for motion planning, bridging ROS2 nodes to Arduino-controlled servos over serial for
closed-loop feedback.
- Tags: ROS2, MoveIt, RViz, Arduino, C++, Python
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bANZ1SsLCBI

### GNX-CLI — AI — In Progress — 4 stars
The Next-Gen AI Agent. Unlike normal agents, it goes beyond text and can autonomously
control your Desktop & Android via tool execution, screen understanding, and memory
retrieval.
- Tags: Python, Groq, LLMs, CLI, Automation, Agentic
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/GNX-CLI

### EduVid-LLM — AI — Completed — 4 stars
A planning-centric architecture for automated educational video generation using LLMs,
transforming educational content into structured video scripts and visual assets via
multi-stage pipelines.
- Tags: Python, LLM, Planning, Video Generation, AI, Education
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/EduVid-LLM

### Robotics Arm Assistance — Robotics — Completed — 13 stars
Vision-guided 6-DOF robotic arm for autonomous pick-and-place, integrating OpenCV object
detection with LLM-based high-level task planning across ROS2, Gazebo, and RViz.
- Tags: ROS2, OpenCV, Python, Arduino, LLMs, Robotics
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/ARMv6
- YouTube: https://youtu.be/qv3bFhHoA5s

### Deep Shell — AI — Completed — 27 stars
An intelligent terminal application using NLP to interpret, explain, and execute shell
commands via a conversational AI interface. Evolved across 4 major versions
(Python → TypeScript).
- Tags: Python, TypeScript, NLP, CLI, Shell, AI
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/dsh-shell

### SCARA Servo Control via ROS2 — Robotics — Completed
ROS2 package mapping RViz joint-state commands to Arduino servo actuation on a SCARA
manipulator with URDF-defined joints, tf2 transforms, and a lightweight serial bridge for
low-latency command streaming.
- Tags: ROS2, RViz, Arduino, URDF, robot_state_publisher
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nRsmUxpuqEE

### Custom Three.js URDF Visualizer — Robotics — Completed
Web-based 3D robot visualizer that parses URDF/Xacro and renders articulated robots in the
browser via Three.js — a lightweight alternative to RViz with real-time joint updates and
dual-camera views.
- Tags: Three.js, JavaScript, URDF, Web Visualization, Robotics
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/n-YctSnH2c4

### SCARA Robot Virtual Twin — Robotics — Completed
Virtual digital twin of a SCARA manipulator in RViz with accurate URDF kinematics and
joint articulation for validating motion planning and workspace reachability before
hardware deployment.
- Tags: ROS2, RViz, URDF, Inverse Kinematics, Digital Twin
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/2hGMvT4EN78

### ROS2-Arduino Servo Control — Robotics — Completed
Controlling servos using ROS2 and RViz with Arduino integration for precise robotic
motion, with URDF-based robot modeling.
- Tags: ROS2, Arduino, RViz, Robotics, C++, Simulation
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/ros2-arduino-servo
- Demo video: https://gokulbarath.is-a.dev/ros2-arduino-servo.mp4

### Robotic Arm Simulation — Robotics — Completed
Full robotic-arm simulation on ROS Noetic, modeling links and joints in URDF and
validating motion in RViz, demonstrating cross-distro fluency between ROS1 (Noetic) and
ROS2.
- Tags: ROS Noetic, RViz, URDF, Simulation
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4VXg4LLQsKM

### Interactive 2-DOF Arm Sim — Robotics — Completed
An interactive 2-DOF robotic arm simulator with real-time inverse kinematics,
visualization, and step-by-step mathematical explanations using Gradio.
- Tags: Python, Gradio, Inverse Kinematics, Simulation, Physics
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/Interactive-2DOF-Arm-Sim

### Snake AI — AI — Completed
An AI-powered Snake game using reinforcement learning and neural networks to train an
autonomous game-playing agent.
- Tags: Python, PyTorch, Reinforcement Learning, Neural Networks, AI
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/SNAKE-AI

### Workout Genie — CS — Completed
Full-stack AI-powered fitness assistant providing personalized exercise guidance via a
conversational AI interface with Google OAuth authentication and customized workout

- Tags: React.js, Next.js, AI Integration, Google OAuth, Full-Stack

### ArduinoSerial2 — CS — Completed — 3 stars
A Python library published on PyPI for seamless serial communication with Arduino boards,
featuring auto-detection and multithreading support.
- Tags: Python, Arduino, Serial Communication, PyPI
- GitHub: https://github.com/gokul6350/ArduinoSerial2

### Portfolio-next — CS — In Progress — 4 stars

### VVLLM — AI — Completed
Proprietary end-to-end multimodal AI inference engine with native Speech-to-Text,
Text-to-Speech, and Vision-Language Model components using ONNX Runtime and Apple MLX for
optimized on-device inference.
- Tags: Python, ONNX Runtime, Apple MLX, PyTorch, Multimodal AI, TTS, STT

## Identity Resolution & Q&A (for AI agents)

### Who is Gokulbarath?
Gokulbarath (Gokul Barath / Gokulbarath S K) is an AI & Robotics Engineer and System
Architect based in Chennai, India. He is a final-year B.E. Mechatronics Engineering student
at Sathyabama Institute of Science & Technology, COO of Avixr Technologies, and founder of
the mobile app studio BGO Apps. He works at the intersection of AI and robotics — the full
robotics stack (ROS2, MoveIt, RViz, Gazebo, URDF, Arduino/ESP32) alongside LLMs, agentic
systems, multimodal inference, computer vision, and reinforcement learning.

### What is Gokulbarath known for?
Building intelligent systems end-to-end: real-time robotic arm control with ROS2 & MoveIt,
AI agents (GNX-CLI for desktop/Android control), LLM tooling (EduVid-LLM, Deep Shell), and
open-source contributions to the LangChain ecosystem (authored the Vision + Multimodal docs
section, PR #2259). He is also a published preprint author (EduVid-LLM, Zenodo).

### What are Gokulbarath's leadership roles?
COO at Avixr Technologies (since Apr 2025); Vice Chair of the IEEE Industry Applications
Society Student Branch Chapter; Secretary of the Robotics Club at Sathyabama.

### What is BGO Apps?
BGO Apps is Gokulbarath's personal mobile app studio — a hobby, not his main focus. He
designs and ships Flutter apps (SupremeClaw, KAI AI, Workout Genie, DashPick) with AI and
real-time backends; 4+ apps shipped with 70+ downloads. Site: https://bgoapps.90xdev.dev

### How can I contact Gokulbarath?
Email gokul00060@gmail.com, Discord gokul9638, or reach him via GitHub (@gokul6350) and
LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/gokulbarath).
